objective.statement: Discover the full option space for a program by fanning 100 seats across distinct analytic lenses, then reduce to a tiered decision queue.
objective.charter: MANDATE. Run a program-scale discovery fan-out: 94 lens seats each read the problem through ONE declared lens, 2 grounding seats pin the shared ground truth so lens seats do not each re-derive it, 3 synthesisers reduce lens output into a tiered decision queue, and 1 adversarial reviewer attacks the synthesis with the siblings' FULL text in hand - never their digests. The council stops when every LANE clears its own completeness gate, not when the output reaches a byte count: a byte floor rewards padding and killed 84 of 85 terse-but-correct artifacts in the measured precedent. Volume is not evidence. A lane that honestly reports 'nothing found here' has cleared its gate.
success_criteria: every declared lane reports a per-lane completeness verdict
no lane is gated on output size
the adversarial reviewer received full sibling text, not digests
the tiered queue is decomposable back to the lens that produced each item

forbidden_actions: score a lens seat on output volume
collapse two lenses into one seat to save budget

roster.display_name: Grounding seat A - reads the shared substrate ONCE for everyone

context.briefing: Produce ONE pinned digest of the substrate every lens seat needs. Measured precedent: 16 of 25 seats independently re-read the same file and one re-read a single path 22 times; a grounding seat removes an estimated 60-90 duplicate reads per fan-out.

roster.display_name: Grounding seat B - independent second read of the same substrate

context.briefing: Corroborate ground-1's digest with a MECHANICALLY DIFFERENT probe - a different shell, field or measurement. Re-running ground-1's own command is not a second signal.

roster.display_name: Adversarial reviewer - reads siblings' FULL text

context.briefing: You receive the siblings' FULL text, never digests - that was the single highest-value structural choice in the measured corpus and the only mechanism that caught a false premise 8 seats had already built on. Most refutations are OVERCLAIMS, not broken work: if the finding is right but the sentence is wider than its evidence, say REFUTED and give the correctly-scoped version.

sequence.custom_name: per-lane completeness gate (NOT a byte floor)

stopping.source_expression: custom:lane_completeness_ratio >= 1 AND unique_ideas >= 250 AND NOT custom:byte_floor_gate_used == true

conditional_decision_requires: owner ranks the tiered queue before any item is executed

metadata.title: Mega lens fan-out, 100 seats (program discovery)
metadata.notes: SOURCE DESIGN: C-X49 `mega-lens-fanout-100`, global ordinal 49, tier mega, protocols P26/P52/P53, 100 seats, 2 rounds, advisory, OWNER-DECISION YES. || EDITABLE DIALS (the design names these as the ones an owner changes FIRST): (1) lens_list -> participants.count.exact_n plus the lane set that feeds custom:lane_completeness_ratio; drop or add lenses here, never by collapsing two lenses into one seat. (2) lane_gates -> the stopping.expression clauses; each lane's gate is its own completeness verdict. Secondary dials: budgets.tokens (20M), budgets.time_minutes (720 = the design's wall<=12h), targets.unique_ideas, participants.diversity.*. || VOCABULARY MAP (design term -> CouncilSpec enum, because the design doc and this schema use different vocabularies): voting `tiered_decision_queue` -> voting.method `synthesis_only` (the tiered queue IS the synthesis product; no ballot is cast) with consensus.measure `agreement_index`; roles `lens_seat_x94` -> role_templates custom:lens_seat filled by selection.mode `mixed` (6 seats pinned in the roster, 94 auto-selected); `ground_x2` -> custom:ground_truth; `synthesiser_x3` -> synthesizer; `adversarial_reviewer_x1` -> critic. Outcome names map CONSENSUS->decision, MAJORITY_WITH_DISSENT->dissent, IRREDUCIBLE_DISAGREEMENT->irreducible_disagreement, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE->no_decision, CONDITIONAL_DECISION->conditional_decision, DEFER->no_decision, PROOF_OF_IMPOSSIBILITY->proof_of_impossibility. `evidence standard: split_by_lens` has NO structural home: objective.evidence_requirements.anchor_style is a single enum, so it is set to `any` and the split (grounded lenses cite file:line, ideation lenses cite an external domain) is carried in each lens seat's briefing - a real expressiveness gap, not a design choice. || CUSTOM METRICS AND THEIR PRODUCERS: custom:lane_completeness_ratio (number, produced by the per-lane gate runner in protocol stage lane-gate; 1.0 means every declared lane returned a verdict) and custom:byte_floor_gate_used (boolean, produced by a gate-config audit; MUST stay false). The producer cannot be written on the leaf itself: SEM-001 compares parse(source_expression) to stopping.expression by dict equality and councilspec.expression.parse emits neither `producer` nor `note`, so a producer on the leaf makes the spec fail SEM-001 - confirmed with a both-states control in platform/council/_probe_note_vs_source_expression.py. A SEM-012 WARN on each custom leaf is therefore expected and non-blocking. || WHY THE STOPPING RULE IS SHAPED THIS WAY: the third clause is a NOT, which reads oddly until you know the measured failure - a byte floor used as the completeness gate killed 84 of 85 honest, terse artifacts. The rule therefore asserts the gate is per-lane AND that no byte floor is in play. || TOPOLOGY LIMITATION: topology.kind is `committee` with NO committees array, because SEM-006 requires every committee member to be a roster participant_id and the 94 lens seats are auto-selected and so have no roster entry. Declaring lanes structurally would require pinning 100 roster entries. Lane membership is therefore assigned at runtime by the lane-gate stage.
